## Stage 1 — `hh-lab::sweep` (commit A)

- `sweep-registry/1` — `check_registry` strictly decodes the closed
  vocabulary, requires every REQ-XD-201 member per level, the
  upstream locator or `HH-only`, non-upstream constants marked,
  Tier 1 exactly V1–V9, Tier 2 each listed candidate with its
  reason. `freeze_registry` stamps `frozen_sha256` +
  `exploration_identity`; `check_merge` refuses data merging across
  identities (`MergeAcrossIdentities` — a level changed after the
  freeze is a new identity, REQ-XD-202).
- `materialize_level` — the first production consumer of
  `hh_assembly::enumerate`: one override spelling per OFAT
  perturbation → `SweepDesign::OverrideList` → `validate_assembly`
  inside enumerate (a failure routes to `rejected`, then typed
  `UnexpressibleSurface`, never silently) → `resolve` re-pins and
  seals → `LevelSpec.ref_` = the sealed `version_id` (digest-frozen,
  never a mutable string). `overrides` carries the spellings for
  attribution only — `check_level_open` refuses a level opened by
  override (`OpenedByOverride`) or a foreign ref — REQ-XE-124's "no
  runtime interpreter" is a typed refusal, not a convention.
- Declared-delta + liveness (REQ-XE-125): `assembly_delta` +
  `check_doc_delta` — the variant differs in exactly one registered
  slot and every changed path is inside declared `typed_paths`
  (`UndeclaredDelta` on the `.`-descent-normalized comparison);
  `request_diff` + `check_request_diff` — the L1.1 wire diff is
  confined to `declared_request_paths` and non-empty on the level's
  exercising branch else `inert{factor,branch}`;
  `check_executed_leg` distinguishes baseline rc −1 (declared
  timeout kill) from level rc 0; `check_liveness` dispatches by the
  declared kind — `ExecutorLeg` levels refuse `NoAdmissionPath` on
  request-diff evidence (an L1.1 replay cannot prove executor
  liveness); `Absent` evidence refuses at arm time — declarable but
  unadmitted never silently degrades.
- `sweep_baseline_doc` / `sweep_seeded_store` / `materialize_v5` —
  the declared sweep baseline (mini-shaped fixture doc, honest as
  such: the first-pass mini HIR document is E2-T9's unlanded Stage
  2) + seeded model_port/control_strategy/context_policy store;
  `materialize_v5` runs the whole chain deterministically.
- `check_v5_declaration` — sha256 byte-equality against R6.33's
  recorded `e950043f…`; a mismatch refuses `DeclarationMismatch`,
  never edited to fit (the "say it differently" test mutates a
  member and refuses).
- `v5_level_entry` / `sweep_registry_record` — the committed
  `sweep-registry/1` author: V1–V9 verbatim from §8.1 (typed paths,
  baseline→level, exercising condition, activation metric, forecast
  source, cost prior, dependency tickets, upstream locator),
  Tier 2's seven candidates each with reason + admission_route.

## Stage 2 — `hh-runner::sweep` + schedule/cohort (commit B)

- `hh-runner-sweep/1` `SweepDecl` — the drive packet's `sweep`
  member: `{registry_sha256, level_id, level_name, factor_id,
  level_ref, baseline{participant_ref, version, digest}, cohort_id,
  departure, label}` — strict decode, every member required.
- `phase4_cohort_id` — `p4-cohort:sha256:<sha256>` over the exact
  baseline H + sealed level ref; an H change mints a new cohort
  (REQ-XD-220's "new phase-4 cohort" is derived, not named).
- `check_sweep_decl` — cohort recomputes, `departure` cites AR-33
  (ADR-0439's admitted concurrency-with-L2 departure), `label` is
  REQ-XH-115's verbatim string (X-08 — no paraphrase, no parity).
- `sweep_arm_ok` — the V5 slot gate: `definition_version_id` = the
  sealed `level_ref` (every slot names its document), the
  `level_assignment` names `{factor → level}` (REQ-XE-126
  attribution), the cohort recomputes, and `l1_gate_match`
  recomputes the pass id over the *baseline* identity — a pass
  minted for any other H refuses; the level doc itself is not the
  pass identity (a level doc would diverge L1.1 by construction).
- `coordinator::drive_window` — the V5-arm member's withholding
  branch: `packet.sweep` absent or `sweep_arm_ok` false ⇒
  `withheld{l1_not_passed}` (R6.41's closed disposition spelling —
  no new member minted). Cost-only withholding stays FP-E's.
- `l1_drive::ToyMini.replay_reasoning` — the declared V5 fixture
  model knob (`transcript_render.assistant_replay.reasoning`):
  `false` drops `reasoning_content` from replayed assistant
  messages — the declared wire effect at L1.1.
- `fp_sweep` emitter + `scripts/fp-sweep-inputs.txt` + committed
  records `docs/build/reports/2026-11-11-fp-sweep-registry.{json,sha256}`
  + `…-fp-sweep-v5.{json,sha256}`; `scripts/check-fp-sweep.sh` —
  emit-identical, sha256, canonical/declaration/sealed-ref legs,
  both batteries.

## Deviations / non-automatically-verifiable behavior

- The sweep baseline is a declared fixture document — the
  first-pass mini HIR document is E2-T9's unlanded Stage 2. The
  registry's `baseline.note` records this verbatim; V5's sealed
  ref is over the declared baseline.
- The executed leg is exercised at fixture scale (60 ms/5 s); the
  production check is the same `check_executed_leg` at the declared
  30 s/120 s values — the record cannot run a 45 s sleep offline.
- V1–V4, V6–V9 are declared, not sealed (first-pass scope FP-6):
  only V5 is materialized; `override_spellings` is recorded for
  every sealed level.
- DF-R6.23-1 stays open — not owned by this ticket.
